astrology.name: Astrology
astrology.description: Draws the sky on Molty, the zodiac wheel with aspects, planet globes, the signs, eclipses and transits. Play it with the molty-astro skill.

atlas.name: Sky atlas
atlas.description: The night sky's best known objects as cards drawn in dots, and where each is now. Turn the rim to browse, tap the middle to open or turn.

cat.name: Cat
cat.description: A small cat that lives on the screen, with its own moods and gestures. Built into every Molty; install only for a newer version.

duck.name: Duck
duck.description: A round little duck that lives on the screen, with its own moods and gestures. Built into every Molty; install only for a newer version.

octopus.name: Octopus
octopus.description: An octopus that lives on the screen, arms always moving, with its own moods and gestures. Built into every Molty; install only for a newer version.

rhythm.name: Rhythm
rhythm.description: A rhythm Molty plays and draws as a clock, a ring a drum. Tap the middle to play or stop; turn the rim to choose or for the tempo.

waves.name: Waves
waves.description: A chord Molty plays with one drum and draws on one circle, its outline the wave. Tap the middle to play or stop; turn the rim to choose or for the pitch.
